description.value: A white mage can regain her MP quicker. The white mage must be relaxed and must be free from overt distractions, such as combat raging nearby or other loud noises. For example, she could be riding in the back of a carriage and benefit from this ability. The white mage does not gain this recovery if she is asleep or unconscious. The white mage regains 1 MP per hour. This increases by 1 for every five white mage levels after 5th.
